snippet.title: Hunting Simulator 3 | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Mark your calendar!

Hunting Simulator 3 is coming to PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5 on October 29, 2026!

Embark on an all-new hunting adventure across the breathtaking landscapes of Colorado and Texas. Track a wide variety of animals unique to each region, explore the wilderness, and team up with your loyal hunting dog as you set out on the perfect hunt.

Add Hunting Simulator 3 to your wishlist today!

Follow us: https://linktr.ee/huntingsim
